title: Maji Maji Rebellion
summary: Africans across German East Africa rose in armed rebellion against German colonial rule. Between 75,000 and 300,000 people died, overwhelmingly from famine.
why: A large uprising against colonial rule; most deaths came from a famine caused largely by German scorched-earth tactics.

notes.problem: Omits the cause the source gives: 'German scorched earth policy deliberately caused famine'.
